desc: A bold tale of courage: Corren Rofell and Belbris Talia journey toward the Kepler Belt, where the simulation void will decide everything. Book 17 in the Signature Science Fiction collection — a complete original novel. Inspired by Based on dossier JAH-LEAK-B25784.
